items.title: Actual Windows/shared-ESP and Secure Boot validation
items.observation: Existing CI preserves a synthetic adjacent disk only. A separate local UEFI/Secure Boot VM was prepared but never booted; no Windows ISO was available; user cancelled verification.
items.next_action: Only after a renewed request: install real Windows in a disposable virtual disk, install MadX into free space, and test both boot paths.
acceptance: Windows boots before and after MadX installation
Windows data/MSR and Microsoft EFI files preserved
Both firmware boot entries work across reboots

items.title: Automatic fallback for VirtualBox with no usable accelerated renderer
items.observation: niri failed with software EGL renderers skipped/no allocator despite a render node. Guest-only nested/pixman/software-GPU settings restored welcome desktop.
items.next_action: Reproduce and implement a bounded fallback without weakening Electron isolation or overriding valid accelerated configurations.
acceptance: Fresh VM reaches desktop without manual session.env edit
Actual screenshot and renderer logs retained

items.title: Visible encrypted-disk unlock prompt
items.observation: User's encrypted VM appeared stuck at splash; text-console unlock succeeded. Automated tests disable splash and do not prove the graphical prompt.
items.next_action: Collect real Plymouth/journal evidence and reproduce prompt rendering before changing theme or boot arguments.
